WITH joined AS (
  SELECT a.frequency, t.type, t.amount, t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
),
signed AS (
  SELECT frequency,
         CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
              WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
         END AS signed_amount,
         balance
  FROM joined
),
per_freq AS (
  SELECT frequency,
         AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed,
         AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM signed
  GROUP BY frequency
),
mean_freq AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed
  FROM per_freq
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.avg_signed,
         p.avg_balance,
         p.avg_signed - m.mean_signed AS excess
  FROM per_freq p
  CROSS JOIN mean_freq m
  WHERE p.avg_signed > m.mean_signed
)
SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_of_avg_signed,
       AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_of_avg_balance,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with type 'VYBER' or any other type get a NULL signed amount, so AVG skips them. The per-frequency signed average is taken over PRIJEM/VYDAJ rows only, and the per-frequency balance average is taken over all of that frequency's joined transactions. Frequencies with no PRIJEM/VYDAJ rows have no average and are left out of the plain mean.
The per-frequency averages are computed at the transaction level (each transaction weighted equally within its frequency), not as an average of per-account averages.
